subject: english
title: REVIEW MIDTERM 1 (PART 2) - LUYỆN ĐỀ GIỮA KÌ 1
subTitle: Comparative Adjectives, Connectors (both, too, but), Blooket Midterm Challenge

cards.vietnamese: So sánh hơn: Tính từ ngắn (adj + -er than) | Tính từ dài (more + adj than)
cards.definition: Comparing two items. Irregular: good -> better than, bad -> worse than.
cards.example: The desert is drier than the forest. This exam is more difficult than the last one.

cards.vietnamese: Both (cả hai) | Too (cũng vậy, đứng cuối câu) | But (nhưng, chỉ sự tương phản)
cards.definition: Both and too show similarity; but shows difference or contrast.
cards.example: We both study hard. He likes music, and I like music too. I called, but he didn't answer.

exercises.question: Mount Everest is ________ than any other mountain on Earth.
exercises.explanation: High là tính từ ngắn 1 âm tiết, dạng so sánh hơn là higher than.

exercises.question: My father loves drinking tea, and my mother likes tea, ________.
exercises.explanation: Từ 'too' (cũng vậy) đứng ở cuối câu khẳng định.
